items: The legal edge of the site: pts are the corners as [x, z] metres around the record's origin, closed into a loop. It draws no solid — a survey line at ground level with a peg every 5 m, labelled with its area in m2 (ha over a hectare). The Site boundary tool clicks the corners in; a setback makes a second, inset one. Nothing of it is built in Blender.
